title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space and defense sectors are buzzing with activity as new strategies and funding rounds emerge. Notably, the U.K. is gearing up for a fresh space strategy while defense spending continues to bolster Europe’s space economy.

themes.title: New U.K. Space Strategy
themes.body: The U.K. government is preparing to unveil a new space strategy, signaling a potential shift in its approach to space policy. This could have ripple effects across the European space landscape as nations recalibrate their priorities.

themes.title: Defense Spending Boosts Space
themes.body: In Europe, increased defense budgets are providing a much-needed lift to the space economy. This trend could catalyze further investment in satellite technology and space infrastructure.

themes.title: Funding Rounds Flourish
themes.body: Flexell Space's $20 million Series A and True Anomaly's $190 million Series C highlight a growing appetite for investment in the space sector. As the defense-tech IPO window creaks open, expect more startups to seek capital.

themes.title: SDA and Missile-Tracking Expansion
themes.body: L3Harris and Sierra Space's collaboration on a new satellite constellation aims to enhance the U.S. missile-tracking network. This initiative underscores the increasing intertwining of defense capabilities with space technology.
